headline: Record sales but currency swings crush operating profit
summary_short: LG Innotek reported Q3 revenue of ₩6.37T, up 18.6% y/y, but operating profit fell 53.4% to ₩94.8B and EPS fell to ₩4,024 from ₩5,425.
summary_long: Operating profit was ₩94.8B versus ₩245.7B in Q2, and net profit was ₩95.2B, down 25.8% y/y. Press reports attribute the profit drop mainly to currency movements, with the won-dollar rate shifting between raw material purchases and shipments. Optical Solutions revenue was ₩5.40T, up 20.6%.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue, operating profit and segment figures are from Korean press coverage of the preliminary Oct. 27, 2026 results; EPS comparisons are from the shard. The shard reported date is Nov. 12; the summary uses the Oct. 27 results date.
